name: PostalCodeInput
description: an input for entering a postal or ZIP code
status: beta — implemented and unit-tested in all seven frameworks with an axe-clean demo page; not yet exercised in composed flows
aria: `aria-label={label}` -- provides an accessible name for the input since no visible `<label>` element is included
keyboard: No keyboard interactions — this is a passive element
props: `value`: string (default: `""`, bindable) -- current postal code value, supports two-way binding
`required`: boolean (default: `false`) -- whether the field is required
`disabled`: boolean (default: `false`) -- whether the field is disabled
`...restProps`: any additional HTML attributes spread onto the input
